title: Supportive Listening: How to help someone feel heard
summary: A quick intro! When someone close to us is struggling, we want to help, so we jump in with advice, "don't worry", or a quick fix. Often, what helps more is simpler: listening so they feel heard. In this course, you'll practise exactly that. You'll meet someone going through a tough time and talk to them out loud, in voice conversations that respond to what you say. Who it's for Anyone who wants to be there for friends and family when they're struggling. Beginner level, no experience needed! title: [test] Gatekeeper Training [Course Variant 1]
summary: Learn to notice early warning signs, open supportive conversations, and connect students to institutional help. As an educator in a high-pressure coaching environment, you’re often the first to see when a student is carrying too much. This training doesn’t ask you to diagnose or counsel. It helps you do the part that’s already yours: noticing, asking, and making sure the student reaches the right person.
